note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #24, Q2 2024 Government Performance) keeps INEGI columns bp3_1_01..bp3_1_16, bp3_1_99, bp3_2, bp3_2a, bp3_3, bp3_4, bp3_5, bp3_6 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0624.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's Q2 data dictionary labels each BP3_* column (e.g. BP3_1_02 'Problemas que enfrenta la ciudad: Deficiencias en la red publica de drenaje'; BP3_2 'Efectividad del gobierno de su ciudad para resolver problemas'; BP3_3 'Realizacion de tramite, pago o solicitud de forma directa ante un(a) servidor(a) publico(a) o empleado(a) de gobierno'; BP3_5 'Contacto directo con autoridades de seguridad publica (transito, municipales, estatales u otras)'; BP3_6 'Practica de corrupcion experimentada: ... por parte de policias de transito, municipales, estatales u otras autoridades de seguridad publica'); 23/23 agree in content with the Q2 questionnaire item carrying the same code number (3.1 options 01-16, 99; 3.2; 3.2a; 3.3-3.6). Cross-check (route 9 style): all 23 live item vectors reproduce the raw INEGI Q2 2024 CSV after the .do's recodes -- 48/48 item x level counts (e.g. bp3_1_01 0/1 = 7334/16780, bp3_1_99 0/1 = 24090/24, bp3_2 1/2/3/4 = 948/6493/10077/5948, bp3_2a 1/2 = 7206/16083, bp3_3 1/2 = 7942/16158, bp3_4 1/2 = 771/7167, bp3_5 1/2 = 3182/20927, bp3_6 1/2 = 1451/1728); raw 24114 rows = 24114 live ids. Routing (not a defect): bp3_2 blank in raw for 538 = 514 (bp3_1_16 Ninguno) + 24 (bp3_1_99), matching 'SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 16 ... O 99 ..., PASE A 3.2a'; bp3_4 non-blank for exactly the 7942 bp3_3=Si (No/NS 'PASE A 3.5'); bp3_6 non-blank for exactly the 3182 bp3_5=Si (No/NS 'PASE A CP4'). Words: item_text / section_prompt are the administered Q2 questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials); all 31 distinct Spanish strings shipped (3.1 stem, 17 options, 3.2-3.6 stems, CP3, printed options) are found in the Q2 PDF's text layer (pp.4-5) after whitespace normalisation, and 200/150-dpi renders of pp.4-5 were read to confirm. Unlike Q1, the Q2 text layer carries every 3.1 option, so nothing rests on a render alone. Q2 vs Q1 (checked, not assumed): 3.1-3.2a wording identical to batch_673 except option 12, printed 'fraudes, etcétera.)' in Q2 (Q1 'etcétera)') -- kept as printed; 3.3-3.6 and CP3 are Q2-only. Kept as printed: '(CIUDAD)' fill, '(a)' gender fills. Normalised: double space in 06 'limpia y  recoleccion' collapsed; line wraps joined with a space. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blank after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'C'; CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES / UN SOLO CODIGO; skip instructions PASE A 3.2a / 3.5 / CP4). Tarjeta C is not in the questionnaire zip and was not transcribed. Structure: section _1 = 3.1 (stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _2 = 3.2, _3 = 3.2a, _4 = 3.3+3.4 (CP3 read-aloud definition of 'persona servidora publica' in section_prompt; it precedes 3.3 and defines the term 3.3/3.4 use), _5 = 3.5, _6 = 3.6; instructions blank -- Section III has no whole-section introduction. Options: bp3_1_* are 0/1 flags for a circled code; option_text is INEGI's catalogo label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si', identical in all 17 catalogos), not questionnaire print. bp3_2 1-4 = Muy/Algo/Poco/Nada efectivo; bp3_2a, bp3_3-bp3_6 1/2 = Si/No -- printed in the questionnaire and identical in catalogos; code 9 'No sabe / no responde' has no row (set missing by the .do). Every level each item's respondents used has an option row. Step 3b: live items match this question block exactly (23 = 17 + 1 + 1 + 4); dictionary Description ('Resident evaluations of local and federal government security performance, Q2 2024') overstates it -- no item asks about the federal government; the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2024 Q2 (file suffix 0624) wave -- same defect as the siblings. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation); 3.1-3.2a English reused from batch_673 (option 12's English unchanged, the Spanish differs only by a period); INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2024, segundo trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section III (questions 3.1-3.6) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
